newsitem.title: UK: Clinton to address British Cabinet.
newsitem.headline: Clinton to address British Cabinet.

text.p: U.S. President Bill Clinton will address new British Prime Minister Tony Blair's cabinet during a visit to London next week, the Sunday Times reported.
Clinton is to have lunch on Thursday with Blair, who swept to power in a landslide election victory on May 1.
The Sunday Times said the U.S. president's visit to the prime minister's official residence, 10, Downing Street, would be timed to coincide with the closing minutes of a regular cabinet meeting.
"The president is expected to address ministers for about five minutes, although some diplomats fear he may carry on for longer," the newspaper said.
